title: Easy Portable Crafting Table
description: Allows you to use the crafting table by command or using a special item.
body: This plugin grants the ability to use a crafting table by using the command "/epct open" or by crafting a special item, called "Portable Crafter". Which you can get by using a simple stick combined with a crafting table block, see recipe below: ____________________________________________________________________________________ ![recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45b10f559c54663d6c57a612c0b44ceede33b628.png) _____________________________________________________________________________________ The special item is just a stick with the enchantment visual effect. To use it just put it on your hand and right click it. Sorry about the design but I dont want to be adding extra texturepacks to run this on a server. so I tried to make it as simple as possible for my server. The command is very useful specially if you are using a macro-keys client mod like [command keys mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/commandkeys) so you can just add a specific key to run that command and open the CT. _____________________________________________________________________________________ Installation is simple: drop the .jar into your plugins folder, restart your server. _____________________________________________________________________________________
